V+Fenar leave compound unnoticed ~21:13, no damage/spell/resources spent, original site bell still audible, no new guard movements invented. Continue through known western/southern wooded route toward Mara's coach originally~0.5mi south. Cirren independent Knowledge Cleric (51/51 HP, full spell slots/CD2) has escorted all eleven willing liberated patients since~20:45: P1–P6/P10–P11 eight ambulatory, P7–P9 three unable walk lying flat on three institutional stretchers with willing bearers. All11 alive, none injured additionally, three still require medical assessment/flat transport, no spell, healing potion or medical recovery imposed; Mara independent adult healthy, checks blankets; Cirren offers ordinary carried water without a tracked ration debit. Coach and four V-owned horses healthy. Coach seating/capacity for three prone stretchers+eight other patients and party NOT verified; no automatic loading, movement farther away, medical-care acceptance, lodging, payment or patient sanctuary. Existing Hedra Tann farm (2mi south) has refused hiding fugitives; Sedgecross wayhouse/sick-tender ~8mi from Kestrel remains unvisited/uncontracted, no free local medics. This resolves exiting Kestrel and rejoining party, NOT safe long-term care or formal facility closure, and does not grant trust reward.
